src: train sprite s (cc containing 8) with attached coupler-9s and divider-color markers
dst: dock onto station group d (8-connected isolated 9s; no adjacent 8 in 8-neighborhood)
transform: erase s; rotate/flip then translate so s.coupler9s == d; do not paint 9s (stations stay)
rotation_rule: orient s so its divider-color markers face the boundary stripes of d’s region (relative to coupler centroid)
